extra.reason: Added table metadata read/write to per-attempt cost. Non-inlined: 4 ops (TM_r + ML_r×N + ML_w×N + TM_w). Inlined: 2N ops (ML only). 862 tests pass.
Added compare pipeline, exp5_vs_exp6_compare.toml with 7 overlay plots, completed plot declarations for all 8 exp5/exp6 configs.
Verified exp5/exp6 produce correct results. Fixed CAS size scaling bug. 9 integration tests + analysis pipeline verified with full-duration runs. 872 tests pass.

Template-hash drift detection shipped: compute_template_hash stamps template_path/template_hash/template_overrides into generated variants; expctl flags stale (template) when source diverges. 888 tests green, end-to-end demo confirms flip→detection.

expctl now reports code/self-hash/template/template-missing independently; version.txt code_hash is compared to current simulator hash as the code-drift signal, and self-hash is suppressed when code drifted (natural digest mismatch). 892 tests pass including 4 new TestCodeVsSelfHashDistinction cases.

Fixed all four bugs: (1) real position-append physical check via expected_log_offset, (2) success determined at server-eval half-RTT not post-discovery-read, (3) split-yield for both read() and commit(), (4) per-partition version preconditions replacing global seq check. Added log_offset to CatalogSnapshot, expected_partition_versions to IntentionRecord, expected_log_offset to Catalog.commit(). Transaction._commit_loop builds full IntentionRecord. AppendCatalog increments table versions for commutative writes. Config.py wired to construct AppendCatalog for mode=append. 12 new regression tests, all 905 tests pass.

Implemented VO read-set tracking. Transaction gains partitions_read field. WriteOverlap tracks read_overlapping separately. compute_write_overlap checks read-set partitions. PartitionOverlapConflictDetector checks read+write sets. Workload generates read sets for VO (default: same as write set; distinct distributions via read_partitions_per_txn and read_selection config). AppendCatalog IntentionRecord includes read-set partition expectations. 13 new tests, all 918 pass. Backward compatible: no RNG state change for existing configs.
